essence: The union of smallest toe and thumb is applied in stopping to satisfy.
One proceeds through the three-row order after knowing it properly with one mind.
The guru row is traversed stepwise by the siddha hosts.
Banana and other fruits, as well as betel, should be offered.
The question asks what else about substance preparation and purification one wishes to hear.
